newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan sees no further steps to boost China trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan sees no further steps to boost China trade.

text.p: Taiwan government said on Friday it would not launch further measures to boost economic links with rival China in the near future, two days after South Africa announced it would switch recognition to Beijing from Taipei.

"We will not add major measures to promote openness (with China) in the near term, particularly in trade and economics," Kao Koong-lian, vice chairman for the Mainland Affairs Council, told reporters.
South African President Nelson Mandela said on Wednesday Pretoria would switch diplomatic ties to Beijing from Taipei by the end of 1997.
The council, Taiwan's top policymaking body towards China, accused Beijing of coercing Pretoria into the switch.
"Communist China's way of killing off Taiwan has escalated the extreme hostility Taiwan's people feel towards communist China," Kao said.
